name: External Person Identification 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external person identification scheme name code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|The list of valid codes is an external code list published separately.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

ARNU.name: Alien Registration Number
ARNU.definition: Number assigned by a social security agency to identify a non-resident person.

CCPT.name: Passport Number
CCPT.definition: Number assigned by an authority to identify the passport number of a person.

CUST.name: Customer Identification Number
CUST.definition: Number assigned by an issuer to identify a customer.

DRLC.name: Drivers License Number
DRLC.definition: Number assigned by an authority to identify a driver's license.

EMPL.name: Employee Identification Number
EMPL.definition: Number assigned by a registration authority to an employee.

NIDN.name: National Identity Number
NIDN.definition: Number assigned by an authority to identify the national identity number of a person.

SOSE.name: Social Security Number
SOSE.definition: Number assigned by an authority to identify the social security number of a person.

TELE.name: Telephone Number
TELE.definition: Number assigned by a telephone or mobile phone operator to identify a person. A person may have multiple phone numbers.

TXID.name: Tax Identification Number
TXID.definition: Number assigned by a tax authority to identify a person.

BANK.name: Bank Party Identification
BANK.definition: Unique and unambiguous assignment made by a specific bank or similar financial institution to identify a relationship as defined between the bank and its client.
